Parametric bootstrap for Hawkes MLE confidence intervals

Source: R/parametric_bootstrap.R
parametric_bootstrap.Rd

Parametric bootstrap for Hawkes MLE confidence intervals

Usage

parametric_bootstrap(
  hawkes,
  est,
  B,
  alpha = 0.05,
  parallel = FALSE,
  max_iters = 500,
  boundary = NULL,
  temporal_burnin = NULL,
  spatial_burnin = NULL
)

Arguments

hawkes

A hawkes object.

est

A hawkes_mle object providing initial parameter estimates.

B

Number of bootstrap iterations. At least 1000 is recommended.

alpha

Significance level for confidence intervals. Defaults to 0.05.

parallel

Logical flag for furrr based parallel computation. Configure a multisession plan before calling when TRUE.

max_iters

Maximum EM iterations for each refit. Defaults to 500.

boundary

Optional boundary width used for edge correction.

temporal_burnin

Temporal burn-in used when simulating bootstrap samples.

spatial_burnin

Spatial burn-in radius used when simulating bootstrap samples.

Value

A tibble of bootstrap summary statistics.

Examples

params <- list(
  background_rate = list(intercept = -4.5, z = 1),
  triggering_rate = 0.5,
  spatial = list(mean = 0, sd = 0.75),
  temporal = list(rate = 2),
  fixed = list(spatial = "mean")
)
data("example_background_covariates")
hawkes <- rHawkes(
  params,
  c(0, 50),
  example_background_covariates,
  covariate_columns = "z",
  spatial_burnin = 1
)
est <- hawkes_mle(hawkes, inits = params, boundary = 1)

# Demonstration with few bootstrap iterations (use at least 1000 in practice)
parametric_bootstrap(hawkes, est, B = 5, boundary = c(0.5, 3))
#> # A tibble: 6 × 8
#>   parameter_type  parameter       boot_est_median  lower  upper  width     sd
#>   <chr>           <chr>                     <dbl>  <dbl>  <dbl>  <dbl>  <dbl>
#> 1 background_rate intercept                -4.41  -4.58  -4.03  0.548  0.249 
#> 2 background_rate z                         0.956  0.886  1.07  0.185  0.0801
#> 3 spatial         mean                      0      0      0     0      0     
#> 4 spatial         sd                        0.705  0.659  0.718 0.0591 0.0250
#> 5 temporal        rate                      1.65   1.48   2.00  0.526  0.243 
#> 6 triggering_rate triggering_rate           0.584  0.529  0.612 0.0837 0.0386
#> # ℹ 1 more variable: percent_failed <dbl>

#future::plan(future::multisession, workers = future::availableCores())

parametric_bootstrap(hawkes,
                     est,
                     B = 2,
                     #B = 1000,
                     parallel = FALSE,
                     #parallel = TRUE,
                     boundary = c(0.5, 3))
